learner: Bayesian logistic regression, diagonal Laplace posterior, prior N(0,1), per-row updates; act by Thompson sampling (scripts/policy/learn.py)
source: src/lib/studio-style.ts StyleRecord (version 2), written onto every Studio take as its style
context: look (color) and motion, logged as context

reward.primary: the published take outperformed 3x within 72 hours (the velocity poller's read)
reward.outcome: views at 72 hours over the owner's channel median

logging.store: pax2-ledger originals (src/lib/originals.ts): ORIG#<id> META carries style and styleLabel; EVENT# published carries youtubeId
logging.propensity: the Studio's suggested style is sampled from the posterior; the sampled style and its probability are written onto META as styleSuggested and styleSuggestedP, beside the style the owner kept

replay: none: a read-only scan of pax2-ledger on 2026-10-22 found 0 originals carrying a style record (102 originals indexed)

epochMarker.rule: No replay; every update is a live decision logged as above.

evaluation: Once 1,000 logged decisions exist: the standard protocol of docs/briefs/WINDOW-P2.md with the logged propensities in place of estimated ones (IPS is then unbiased), registered in the brief before the first fit.
